topic.label: Accounting and Audit
topic.desc: Accounting and Audit: Audit and Internal Controls, Management and Cost Accounting, Bookkeeping and the General Ledger and GAAP and IFRS.

concepts.label: Audit and Internal Controls
concepts.desc: External audit, internal controls, SOX, materiality and audit evidence.

concepts.label: Bookkeeping and the General Ledger
concepts.desc: Double-entry bookkeeping, chart of accounts, journal entries, reconciliation and closing the books.

concepts.label: Management and Cost Accounting
concepts.desc: Budgets, cost allocation, unit economics and variance analysis for decisions.

concepts.label: GAAP and IFRS
concepts.desc: Accounting standards: US GAAP, IFRS, revenue recognition, leases and differences between them.

skills.label: Control Gap Finder
skills.desc: Finds gaps in internal controls over a financial process.

skills.label: Bank Reconciliation
skills.desc: Reconciles a bank statement to the ledger and lists unmatched items.

skills.label: Journal Entry Builder
skills.desc: Builds double-entry journal entries for a transaction and checks debits equal credits.

skills.label: Unit Economics Calculator
skills.desc: Computes contribution margin, CAC, LTV and payback for a business.

skills.label: Variance Analyzer
skills.desc: Explains budget versus actual variances by driver.

skills.label: GAAP vs IFRS Comparator
skills.desc: Compares the GAAP and IFRS treatment of an item and its effect on reported numbers.

skills.label: Revenue Recognition Guide
skills.desc: Applies the five-step revenue recognition model to a contract.

mcp.name: QuickBooks Online MCP
mcp.desc: Intuit QuickBooks Online MCP server: accounting records, accounts, customers, vendors, invoices, bills and journal entries.
